Children's product recalls

Recalls, safety advisories and sale bans on children's products, gathered from four national regulators: the US CPSC, UK OPSS, EU Safety Gate and Health Canada. Covering the last 365 days.

This is a list of what regulators have published — not a statement about anything you own. A recall applies only to the models, batches and serial numbers named in the official notice. Open the notice and check yours against it. Not every entry below is a recall: some products were stopped before they reached anyone, and some are warnings rather than recalls. Each one says which.

1,246 entries as of 24 September 2026. 1,113 could be in a home — 553 recalls and 560 withdrawn or warned. The other 133 were rejected at the border.

The badge on each entry says what the regulator did — not how dangerous the product is. A serious hazard can appear under any of the three. Most entries here are European: 841 from the EU and 228 from the UK, against 104 from the US and 73 from Canada. Finding nothing here is not proof a product is safe — the four regulators publish on their own schedules, and one may not have acted yet.
